sub_graphs.title: Prague Fork: Block State Transition
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition function that applies blocks to the blockchain state, including header validation and body execution

nodes.label: Block Received for Processing
nodes.description: A new block has been received and is ready for state transition processing

nodes.label: Validate Block Header
nodes.description: Validates block header including gas limits, base fee, timestamps, difficulty, nonce, and parent hash

nodes.label: Block Header Validated
nodes.description: Block header has passed all validation checks

nodes.label: Check Ommers Empty
nodes.description: Verifies that ommers hash equals EMPTY_OMMER_HASH (post-PoS requirement)

nodes.label: Create Block Environment
nodes.description: Constructs the execution environment containing coinbase, gas limit, number, timestamp, base fee, etc.

nodes.label: Block Environment Ready
nodes.description: Block execution environment has been created with all necessary context

nodes.label: Apply Block Body
nodes.description: Executes all transactions, processes withdrawals, and handles requests

nodes.label: Block Body Executed
nodes.description: All transactions and withdrawals have been processed

nodes.label: Verify State Root
nodes.description: Compares computed state trie root against block header claim

nodes.label: Verify Transaction Root
nodes.description: Compares computed transaction trie root against block header claim

nodes.label: Verify Receipt Root
nodes.description: Compares computed receipt trie root against block header claim

nodes.label: Verify Gas Used
nodes.description: Ensures computed cumulative gas matches header gas_used

nodes.label: Block Successfully Applied
nodes.description: Block has been fully validated and applied to chain state

nodes.label: Invalid Block Rejected
nodes.description: Block failed validation and was rejected

external_entities.name: Block Producer
external_entities.description: Validator or consensus client that produces and proposes blocks

sub_graphs.title: Prague Fork: Transaction Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the transaction processing flow including validation, execution, and receipt generation

nodes.label: Transaction Pending Validation
nodes.description: Transaction is queued for check_transaction validation

nodes.label: Check Gas Availability
nodes.description: Verifies transaction gas does not exceed remaining block gas

nodes.label: Check Blob Gas Availability
nodes.description: Validates blob gas does not exceed MAX_BLOB_GAS_PER_BLOCK (1,179,648)

nodes.label: Recover Sender Address
nodes.description: Recovers sender from ECDSA signature using secp256k1_recover

nodes.label: Validate EIP-1559 Fees
nodes.description: Ensures max_priority_fee <= max_fee_per_gas and max_fee >= base_fee

nodes.label: Validate Blob Versioned Hashes
nodes.description: Checks blob hashes use KZG version (0x01) and list is non-empty

nodes.label: Validate Sender Nonce
nodes.description: Ensures transaction nonce equals sender account nonce

nodes.label: Check Sender Balance
nodes.description: Verifies sender has sufficient balance for gas + value

nodes.label: Validate Sender is EOA
nodes.description: Ensures sender has no code or valid delegation code

nodes.label: Transaction Validated
nodes.description: Transaction has passed all validation checks

nodes.label: Increment Sender Nonce
nodes.description: Increments sender account nonce before execution

nodes.label: Deduct Gas Fee
nodes.description: Deducts gas × effective_gas_price + blob_gas_fee from sender

nodes.label: Populate Access List
nodes.description: Pre-warms accounts and storage slots from access list

nodes.label: Execute EVM Message
nodes.description: Executes the transaction message via EVM

nodes.label: Calculate Gas Refund
nodes.description: Computes refund as min(gas_used_before_refund/5, refund_counter)

nodes.label: Apply EIP-7623 Floor
nodes.description: Enforces minimum gas as max(gas_after_refund, calldata_floor_cost)

nodes.label: Refund Unspent Gas
nodes.description: Refunds remaining gas to sender at effective gas price

nodes.label: Pay Miner Priority Fee
nodes.description: Transfers priority fee portion to coinbase address

nodes.label: Delete Marked Accounts
nodes.description: Removes accounts marked for deletion during execution

nodes.label: Transaction Processing Complete
nodes.description: Transaction has been fully processed with receipt generated

nodes.label: Transaction Rejected
nodes.description: Transaction failed validation and was not executed

external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
external_entities.description: External user or application that submits transactions

sub_graphs.title: Prague Fork: Gas and Fee Calculations
sub_graphs.description: Models the EIP-1559 dynamic fee mechanism and blob gas pricing

nodes.label: Parent Header Read
nodes.description: Parent block header information has been retrieved for fee calculation

nodes.label: Calculate Parent Gas Target
nodes.description: Computes parent_gas_target = parent_gas_limit / ELASTICITY_MULTIPLIER (2)

nodes.label: Calculate Base Fee Per Gas
nodes.description: Implements EIP-1559 formula to adjust base fee based on gas utilization

nodes.label: Base Fee Computed
nodes.description: Block base fee has been calculated from parent parameters

nodes.label: Calculate Effective Gas Price
nodes.description: Computes min(max_priority_fee, max_fee - base_fee) + base_fee

nodes.label: Calculate Priority Fee
nodes.description: Computes miner tip as effective_price - base_fee

nodes.label: Calculate Blob Gas Price
nodes.description: Determines blob gas price from excess_blob_gas using exponential formula

nodes.label: Calculate Total Blob Gas
nodes.description: Sums blob gas consumed by all blobs in transaction

nodes.label: Calculate Blob Data Fee
nodes.description: Computes blob_gas × blob_gas_price for transaction

nodes.label: All Fees Calculated
nodes.description: Base fee, priority fee, and blob fee have been computed

nodes.label: Validate Gas Limit Change
nodes.description: Ensures gas limit change <= parent/GAS_LIMIT_ADJUSTMENT_FACTOR (1024)

nodes.label: Gas Limit Valid
nodes.description: Block gas limit is within acceptable range of parent

sub_graphs.title: Prague Fork: System Transactions
sub_graphs.description: Models the system transaction execution for beacon roots and history storage

nodes.label: Block Environment Ready
nodes.description: Block environment has been created, ready for system transactions

nodes.label: Execute Beacon Roots System Call
nodes.description: Calls BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS (0x000F3df6D732807Ef1319fB7B8bB8522d0Beac02) with parent beacon root

nodes.label: Execute History Storage System Call
nodes.description: Calls HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS (0x0000F90827F1C53a10cb7A02335B175320002935) with parent hash

nodes.label: Check Contract Code Exists
nodes.description: Validates target contract has deployed code

nodes.label: System Transactions Complete
nodes.description: All system transactions have been executed successfully

nodes.label: System Transaction Failed
nodes.description: System transaction failed - raises InvalidBlock

external_entities.name: System Address
external_entities.description: SYSTEM_ADDRESS (0xfff...ffe) used as origin for system calls

sub_graphs.title: Prague Fork: Request Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the general-purpose request handling for deposits, withdrawals, and consolidations

nodes.label: Transactions Processed
nodes.description: All transactions have been executed, ready to process requests

nodes.label: Parse Deposit Requests
nodes.description: Extracts deposit requests from transaction logs

nodes.label: Call Withdrawal Request Predeploy
nodes.description: Calls WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS to get withdrawal requests

nodes.label: Call Consolidation Request Predeploy
nodes.description: Calls CONSOLIDATION_REQUEST_PREDEPLOY_ADDRESS to get consolidation requests

nodes.label: Order Requests by Type
nodes.description: Maintains ascending request type ordering in output

nodes.label: Requests Collected
nodes.description: All request types have been gathered and ordered

nodes.label: Process Beacon Chain Withdrawals
nodes.description: Increases validator balances by withdrawal amount × 10^9 (Gwei to Wei)

nodes.label: Withdrawals Applied
nodes.description: All withdrawal balances have been credited

external_entities.name: Beacon Chain
external_entities.description: Consensus layer providing withdrawal and deposit information

ambiguities.text: The specification references 'valid delegation code' for sender validation but does not fully specify what constitutes valid delegation
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume delegation code follows EIP-7702 format with proper authorization chain. This should be verified against EIP-7702 specification.

ambiguities.text: The 'rolling 255-block window' mentioned in state_transition is not fully specified in terms of behavior at chain boundaries
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume window starts from genesis and maintains exactly 255 most recent block hashes, returning empty for requests beyond window.

ambiguities.text: The behavior of 'process_unchecked_system_transaction' when execution fails is not clearly specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume unchecked transactions silently fail without propagating errors, while state changes are reverted.

implicit_assumptions.description: The BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS and HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS contracts are assumed to be correctly deployed and immutable at their respective addresses
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: System transactions would fail causing InvalidBlock, potentially halting block production

implicit_assumptions.description: The signature recovery using secp256k1_recover is assumed to be deterministic and correctly implemented
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Transaction sender addresses could be incorrectly recovered, leading to unauthorized fund transfers

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot forge valid ECDSA signatures without knowing the private key
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Complete compromise of account security, allowing arbitrary transaction submission

implicit_assumptions.description: The SYSTEM_TRANSACTION_GAS (30,000,000) is sufficient for all system contract operations
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: System transactions could run out of gas, causing block validation failures
